description: Daily alert volume by transaction-monitoring rule, with historically confirmed suspicious cases and the false-positive rate.
One row per rule-based alert, ranked by the ML alert-priority model (priority_rank 1 = work first), with SHAP risk drivers and the GenAI SAR draft.
Latest analyst disposition per alert, written in the case cockpit (Lakebase) and streamed back to Unity Catalog. Alerts with no row here have not been worked yet.
Customer master with PII masked by Unity Catalog for non-privileged users.

content:
This room supports AML investigators and the Head of Financial Crime at a commercial bank.
Alerts come from a legacy rules-based transaction-monitoring system; most are false positives.
priority_score is the model's probability that an alert is genuinely suspicious; priority_band is HIGH (>0.6), MEDIUM (0.3-0.6) or LOW (<0.3). priority_rank 1 is the most urgent case.
Analyst work status comes from case_status.action: ESCALATE, SAR_FILED or CLOSE_FALSE_POSITIVE. An alert is 'open' when it has no case_status row or its action is ESCALATE.
False-positive rate = 1 - suspicious / alerts, from alert_kpis. Report percentages to one decimal.
Never show national IDs or full email addresses; use customers_governed for customer attributes.

question: Which rules generate the most false positives?
sql: SELECT rule_code, SUM(alerts) AS alerts, SUM(suspicious) AS suspicious, ROUND(100.0 * (1 - SUM(suspicious) / SUM(alerts)), 1) AS false_positive_pct FROM serverless_stable_unstructured_catalog.aml_gold.alert_kpis GROUP BY rule_code ORDER BY alerts - suspicious DESC

question: How many high-priority alerts are still open?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_high_priority FROM serverless_stable_unstructured_catalog.aml_gold.case_queue q LEFT JOIN serverless_stable_unstructured_catalog.aml_gold.case_status s ON q.alert_id = s.alert_id WHERE q.priority_band = 'HIGH' AND (s.action IS NULL OR s.action = 'ESCALATE')

question: Show analyst dispositions by outcome
sql: SELECT action, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM serverless_stable_unstructured_catalog.aml_gold.case_status GROUP BY action ORDER BY cases DESC
